subject: Canary onramp & trial acceptance: API routing, streaming, and ownership
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@tidalretail.com>, Ethan Rogers <ethan@tidalretail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed small-scale POC and next steps

Hi Priya / Ethan,

Great speaking earlier — thanks for walking through the three primary product flows you want the POC to validate (search-ranking rerank, customer chat summarization, and order-extraction). Quick recap and proposed path forward so we all have alignment: 

1) Trial scope (2 weeks, non-prod):
   - Surface-level goals: response latency under 350ms median for chat; rerank accuracy uplift >= 12% over baseline; extraction F1 >= 0.88 on sampled orders.
   - Traffic: staged with synthetic traffic + 10% shadowed production traffic in week 2 for real-world signal.

2) Success criteria (please confirm):
   - Latency: median token latency < 350ms (P95 budget at 800ms).
   - Quality: business metric uplift or model eval score thresholds listed above.
   - Integrability: SDK streaming and function-calling working end-to-end with your extractor service.

3) Technical handoffs and owners:
   - Redwood engineering (Dev Patel) will own API routing + streaming endpoints and the canary rollout plan.
   - Tidal platform (Carlos, cc'd once you confirm) will prepare a staging dataset and an accounts-level API key + allowed IPs.
   - Marcus will own instrumentation: tracing, token-level cost breakdown, and alerting for regression.

4) Timeline (proposed):
   - Dec 3: Tech sync (30 min) to confirm auth and streaming route names.
   - Dec 6: SDK drop + integration guide (initial).
   - Dec 8-12: Staged run + monitoring; Dec 14: Acceptance decision.

Attachments: rwi-poc-schedule.xlsx (proposed calendar), tidal-api-mapping.csv (fields we mapped during call).

Next steps: please confirm the success criteria above and suggest a 30-min slot on Dec 3 for the technical sync. If you want Carlos on the thread, add him and we'll loop him in.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference runtime
From: Ethan Rogers <ethan@tidalretail.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@tidalretail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed small-scale POC and next steps

Lauren — thanks for the tight recap. Priya and I are aligned on the three flows and the acceptance thresholds look reasonable. A couple quick clarifications before the tech sync: 

- Streaming and function-calling: our extraction service relies on a streaming, token-forward approach with function calls for confirming parsed entities. Can Redwood support streaming + function-calling in the same session without adding extra round trips?
- Canary: we prefer an initial 5-10% traffic canary with automatic rollback on error rate spike > 1% or latency P95 > 1s.
- Data privacy: we need to confirm whether payloads will be kept for debugging or redacted by default.

Also, please loop in Carlos Mendez (platform lead) — he'll handle the staging environment and provide the test API keys. Carlos: can you join the Dec 3 tech sync at 2:00pm PST?

Ethan Rogers
VP Product, Tidal Retail
ethan@tidalretail.com | (415) 222-0199
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@tidalretail.com>, Ethan Rogers <ethan@tidalretail.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@tidalretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed small-scale POC and next steps

Thanks Ethan — looping in technical specifics so Carlos and your infra team have a starting point before the sync. Summary of what Redwood will deliver for the POC and practical integration notes: 

- SDK & API routes:
  * REST endpoints: POST /v1/generate for one-off text calls; POST /v1/stream for chunked responses (server-sent events + chunked HTTP).
  * Function-calling support is available in both endpoints; we attach a `function_call` object in the token stream and you can ACK/return a follow-up request.
  * Example routes and sample payloads are in rwi-sdk-guide.pdf (attached).

- Authentication & networking:
  * Options: API key with allow-list and short-lived token exchange, or mTLS for dedicated environments. For the POC we recommend API keys + IP allow-list to avoid cert ops.
  * We will accept requests from your staging CIDR (please provide).

- Streaming + function-calling behavior:
  * We can stream tokens and inject a function_call event without extra round trips — the SDK will emit a `function_call` message in the stream and you can pick up the args to invoke your extractor.
  * If you prefer, we can also route function calls to your webhook endpoint (POST /callbacks/function) to keep the call lifecycle server-driven.

- Canary rollout plan (high-level):
  * Week 1 (sandbox): smoke tests with synthetic traffic.
  * Week 2 (staged canary): 5% production traffic routed to POC model variant; auto-triggers: error rate > 1% OR latency P95 > 1s OR quality regression against sample prompts.
  * Fallbacks: immediate fallback to baseline model variant + alert to both teams.

- Observability and instrumentation:
  * Marcus will provision token-level cost dashboards, per-route latency, and a small set of content-quality eval hooks for the acceptance prompts you provided.
  * We will also provide a short Grafana dashboard + a CSV of per-request traces for the run.

- Ownership matrix (who does what):
  * Redwood: route config, canary automation, model variant setup, streaming SDK package.
  * Tidal: test data, staging CIDR and API keys, verification of extractor webhook.
  * Both: acceptance run and joint post-run review.

Attachments: rwi-sdk-guide.pdf, rwi-canary-runbook.md. I can post the minimal curl examples in the sync if helpful.

--
Dev Patel
Senior SWE, Platform — Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
From: Priya Sharma <priya@tidalretail.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed small-scale POC and next steps

Thanks everyone — this looks good and covers the most important items. Quick confirmations from Tidal side: 

- We accept the success criteria and the suggested monitoring triggers for canary rollback.
- We'll provide a staging CIDR and two test API keys by EOD Dec 4 (Carlos will send).
- A couple of asks: please share SOC2 evidence (summary report) before we start shadowing production traffic (target Dec 10). Also need a DocuSign for the MSSA and POC addendum — sending through procurement next week.

Action items:
- Redwood: drop the SDK package + example calls by Dec 6 (Marcus / Dev) and post the HubSpot link to the updated schedule.
- Tidal: Carlos to provide CIDR and keys; procurement to route DocuSign.

Once we have the SOC2 and the SDK artifacts we can start the staged run on Dec 8 as proposed.

Best,
